note: Half-bound at a saunter, a hare's slow gait: both hind feet push off together, the body sails through one flight and both fore feet catch it together, the hinds landing beside them as the fores leave. A leg with phase p plants at 1 - p, so fores at 0.4 with duty 0.42 land at 0.6, leaving a fifth of the cycle in the air after the hinds go; the crest is mid-flight (bobPhase) and the back hollows at the push and arches at the gather (spineFlexPhase), which crouch and the wider fold pay for.
